query:
SELECT 
  p.id, p.name, p.avgCost, p.currentStock, c.name as category,
  (SELECT MAX(DATE(CONVERT_TZ(po.postingDate, '+00:00', '-03:00'))) 
   FROM purchaseOrderItems poi2 
   INNER JOIN purchaseOrders po ON poi2.purchaseOrderId = po.id 
   WHERE poi2.productId = p.id AND po.status = 'CONFIRMED') as lastPurchaseDate,
  (SELECT poi2.unitCost 
   FROM purchaseOrderItems poi2 
   INNER JOIN purchaseOrders po ON poi2.purchaseOrderId = po.id 
   WHERE poi2.productId = p.id AND po.status = 'CONFIRMED'
   ORDER BY po.postingDate DESC LIMIT 1) as lastPurchaseCost
FROM products p
INNER JOIN categories c ON p.categoryId = c.id
WHERE p.active = 1 AND (p.isComposite = 0 OR p.isComposite IS NULL) AND p.currentStock > 0
ORDER BY p.currentStock * p.avgCost DESC
LIMIT 5
